outputs.connectivity_matrix: N x N per target, labelled on both axes
outputs.hit_list: top five ranked residues per target

convention.value: time-averaged CTQW transfer probability between two residues
convention.residue_id: chain:number, matching the apo structure numbering
convention.hit_list_selection: exact fixed-cardinality subset optimisation inside the selected cavity
convention.hit_list_rank: descending hop-normalised propagation score; the subset score is equal across the five by construction and cannot order them
convention.hit_list_ties: residues with an equal propagation score keep matrix-index order
